description: Read chained audit rows, decided-action feature snapshots and anchors with an HMAC-SHA256 signature. No sealed paths/bodies, notes, keys or IPs in the action labels. Legacy actions lack snapshots and are excluded. store_audit=false has no chain. Follow next_from for audit rows and next_actions_after as actions_after for labels (10,000 each). Use API/SDK above the MCP response size limit. Use it to hand an auditor a tamper-evident export; check one with gate_audit_verify.

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...

name: gate_audit_proof
title: Export a signed audit proof
